_comment: Curated denylist of TBC WORLD-BOSS drops (Doomwalker, Doom Lord Kazzak). The item DB carries no source data, and enrich_item_sources doesn't classify world bosses, so the optimizer's include_world_boss=False filter has nothing to act on — letting nearly-unobtainable world-boss gear (e.g. Talon of the Tempest from Doomwalker) outrank obtainable raid loot. The optimizer excludes these item_ids when include_world_boss is False (equipped items are exempt). REVIEW/EXTEND: these are the items we're confident about; add more world-boss drops as needed. Keys are boss names; values map item_id -> name for readability.
